title: Easy Chain flow
description: An Easy Chain flow spec (*.flow.yaml). Each flow compiles to a LangGraph graph. Spec version 1.

model.description: provider:model, for example openai:gpt-4o-mini, anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5 or ollama:llama3.2.
model.title: Model

prompt.description: Flow Data field to send to the model (text or messages). Empty means: what the previous step saved.
prompt.title: Prompt

base_url.description: Custom endpoint, e.g. an OpenAI-compatible server.
base_url.title: Base Url

api_key.description: Name of the secret holding the key, for a custom endpoint (empty: the provider's usual key).
api_key.title: Api Key

output.description: Reply in a fixed shape instead of free text.

AIModelStep.description: Calls a chat model (LangChain chat model via init_chat_model).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

AIModelStep.title: AIModelStep

AgentAddons.description: Agent Add-ons: LangChain agent middleware, switched on with a toggle.

approve_tools.description: Tools that wait for a person to approve, edit or reject each call (HumanInTheLoopMiddleware). The run pauses and the request appears in the Inbox.
approve_tools.title: Approve Tools

max_model_calls.description: Stop after this many model calls in one run.
max_model_calls.title: Max Model Calls

max_tool_calls.description: Stop calling tools after this many in one run.
max_tool_calls.title: Max Tool Calls

tool_errors.description: When a tool fails: tell the agent so it can try another way, or stop the run.
tool_errors.title: Tool Errors

tool_retries.description: Try a failing tool again this many times.
tool_retries.title: Tool Retries

model_retries.description: Try a failing model call again this many times.
model_retries.title: Model Retries

fallback_models.description: Models to try, in order, when the main one fails.
fallback_models.title: Fallback Models

summarise.description: Summarise older messages when the conversation gets long.
summarise.title: Summarise

summarise_after.description: Summarise when the messages pass this many tokens.
summarise_after.title: Summarise After

summarise_keep.description: Keep this many recent messages as they are.
summarise_keep.title: Summarise Keep

clear_tool_results.description: Clear old tool results when the conversation passes this many tokens.
clear_tool_results.title: Clear Tool Results

pii.description: Personal data to catch in what the user sends.
pii.title: Pii

select_tools.description: With many tools: let a model pick this many relevant ones for each request.
select_tools.title: Select Tools

todo_list.description: Give the agent a to-do list for planning longer tasks.
todo_list.title: Todo List

emulate_tools.description: For testing: an AI model pretends to be the tools instead of running them.
emulate_tools.title: Emulate Tools

memory.description: Long-term memory: the agent can remember facts about the user and recall them in later conversations (LangGraph store).
memory.title: Memory

AgentAddons.title: AgentAddons

model.description: The model that thinks and picks tools.
model.title: Model

instructions.default: You are a helpful assistant. Use the tools when they help, and say so when you can't find an answer.
instructions.description: Role and rules (the system prompt). Put Flow Data in with {field}.
instructions.title: Instructions

input.description: What the agent works on: a text field, or a messages field for a chat. Empty means: what the previous step saved.
input.title: Input

tools.description: Steps the agent can use as tools (their ids).
tools.title: Tools

output.description: Answer in a fixed shape instead of free text.

save_messages.description: Also save the agent's whole conversation (tool calls included) here.
save_messages.title: Save Messages

max_steps.description: Most rounds of thinking and tool calls in one run.
max_steps.title: Max Steps

AgentStep.description: An AI that decides which tools to use, in a loop, until it has an answer (create_agent).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

AgentStep.title: AgentStep

kind.description: approve: Approve/Reject. edit: change a field, then Approve/Reject. answer: type a reply. choose: pick one of the options.
kind.title: Kind

field.description: For edit: the field the reviewer can change.
field.title: Field

options.description: For choose: the choices (also the exits).
options.title: Options

notify.description: Send the configured notifications when it pauses.
notify.title: Notify

AskHumanStep.description: Pauses the run until a person answers in the Inbox (LangGraph interrupt).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

AskHumanStep.title: AskHumanStep

Canvas.description: Visual-only data. Kept in its own section so flow diffs stay clean.
Canvas.title: Canvas

code.title: Code

writes.description: Fields this code sets. Empty means: worked out from the returned dict.
writes.title: Writes

side_effect.description: The code changes something elsewhere: run it at most once, even after a retry or a crash.
side_effect.title: Side Effect

CodeStep.description: Action: runs a Python function over Flow Data.

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

CodeStep.title: CodeStep

expression.description: Pro: a safe Python expression over field names, e.g. len(page) > 5000.
expression.title: Expression

exit.description: Decision exit label this connection leaves from.
exit.title: Exit

DataField.description: A named field of Flow Data (LangGraph state key).

update.description: How a new value combines with the old one: replace, append (lists and messages), merge (objects), add (numbers) or custom (a Python function).
update.title: Update

combine.description: For update: custom, Python code defining combine(old, new) -> value.
combine.title: Combine

DataField.title: DataField

input.description: Field the AI reads. Empty means: what the previous step saved.
input.title: Input

max_rounds.description: Leave a loop after this many rounds.
max_rounds.title: Max Rounds

when_max.description: Exit to take when max_rounds is reached (default: otherwise).
when_max.title: When Max

DecisionStep.description: Picks the next step (LangGraph conditional edge).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

DecisionStep.title: DecisionStep

expression.description: Pro: a safe expression, e.g. count + 1.
expression.title: Expression

FlowSettings.description: How runs of this flow behave.

max_steps.description: Stop a run after this many rounds of steps.
max_steps.title: Max Steps

max_parallel.description: Most steps that run at the same time.
max_parallel.title: Max Parallel

double_texting.description: When a new message arrives while a conversation is still running: reject it, queue it, interrupt the current run, or roll it back and start over.
double_texting.title: Double Texting

max_concurrent_runs.description: Most runs of this flow at the same time.
max_concurrent_runs.title: Max Concurrent Runs

FlowSettings.title: FlowSettings

items.description: List field to go through. Empty means: what the previous step saved.
items.title: Items

item_name.description: Field that holds the current item.
item_name.title: Item Name

save_as.description: List of what each item produced, in order.
save_as.title: Save As

ForEachStep.description: Runs a step once for every item in a list, in parallel (LangGraph Send).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

ForEachStep.title: ForEachStep

response.description: readable_text strips HTML down to the words on the page.
response.title: Response

side_effect.description: Changes something elsewhere (sends, pays, deletes): send it at most once, with an Idempotency-Key. Empty means: yes for POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.
side_effect.title: Side Effect

HttpRequestStep.description: Action: calls a URL over HTTP.

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

HttpRequestStep.title: HttpRequestStep

mode.description: form: the flow takes named fields. chat: the flow takes chat messages, kept per conversation in the `messages` field.
mode.title: Mode

InputStep.description: Where a run starts. Declares the fields a run takes (LangGraph START + input schema).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

InputStep.title: InputStep

examples.description: Few-shot example turns placed before the user message.
examples.title: Examples

history.description: Messages field to insert as chat history (e.g. messages).
history.title: History

InstructionsStep.description: Fills a prompt template with Flow Data (LangChain ChatPromptTemplate).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

InstructionsStep.title: InstructionsStep

JumpStep.description: Sets Flow Data and picks the next step in one move (LangGraph Command).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

JumpStep.title: JumpStep

knowledge_base.description: Id of the Knowledge Base to search.
knowledge_base.title: Knowledge Base

embedding_model.description: The embedding model the Knowledge Base was built with (set when you pick it).
embedding_model.title: Embedding Model

query.description: Field with the question. Empty means: what the previous step saved (or what the agent asks, when this step is a tool).
query.title: Query

mode.description: hybrid: by meaning and by words, merged. meaning: embeddings only. words: full-text search only.
mode.title: Mode

rerank_model.description: An AI model that re-orders the passages by relevance.
rerank_model.title: Rerank Model

sources_as.description: The passages as a list (title, source, page, text).
sources_as.title: Sources As

KnowledgeSearchStep.description: Finds the passages of a Knowledge Base that best match a question (a retriever).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

KnowledgeSearchStep.title: KnowledgeSearchStep

McpTools.description: Tools from an MCP server (Settings → MCP servers).

tools.description: Tool names to use; empty means all of them.
tools.title: Tools

McpTools.title: McpTools

fields.description: Flow Data fields returned when the run finishes.
fields.title: Fields

OutputStep.description: Where a run ends. Picks the fields to return (LangGraph END + output schema).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

OutputStep.title: OutputStep

RunPolicy.description: How a step runs: retries, time limit, cache and joining parallel branches.

retry_wait.description: Seconds before the first retry; doubles each time.
retry_wait.title: Retry Wait

timeout.description: Seconds before the step is stopped.
timeout.title: Timeout

cache.description: Reuse the result when the step gets the same inputs again.
cache.title: Cache

cache_ttl.description: Seconds a cached result stays valid.
cache_ttl.title: Cache Ttl

wait_for_all.description: Wait until every parallel branch has finished before running.
wait_for_all.title: Wait For All

RunPolicy.title: RunPolicy

SchemaField.description: One field of a structured reply (becomes a Pydantic field).

description.description: Tells the model what to put here.
description.title: Description

items.description: For list: what each item is.
items.title: Items

fields.description: For object, or a list of objects: their fields.
fields.title: Fields

SchemaField.title: SchemaField

StructuredOutput.description: Make the model reply in a fixed shape (with_structured_output / response_format).

description.description: What the reply is, for the model.
description.title: Description

spread.description: Also save each field as its own Flow Data field.
spread.title: Spread

retries.description: Ask again this many times when a reply doesn't fit.
retries.title: Retries

StructuredOutput.title: StructuredOutput

flow.description: Id of the flow to run as this step.
flow.title: Flow

share_data.description: Share Flow Data with the sub-flow (same field names) instead of mapping it.
share_data.title: Share Data

SubflowStep.description: Runs another flow as one step (LangGraph subgraph).

id.description: Unique id; also the LangGraph node name.
id.title: Id

SubflowStep.title: SubflowStep
